NARULA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY (NIT) - ADMISSION PROSPECTUS
Affiliated to MAKAUT | NAAC 'A' Accredited | NIRF Ranked 9 Years Straight
1. Campus Facilities & Infrastructure:
 - State-of-the-art AI & Robotics Labs, Apple iOS Center, and Smart Classrooms.
- Comprehensive Central Library with over 80,000 volumes, IEEE & Springer digital access.
- High-speed Wi-Fi enabled 10-acre green campus in Agarpara, Kolkata.
2. Training & Placement Records:
 - 88%+ consistent placement rate across CSE, IT, ECE, EE, and Mechanical.
- Top Recruiters: TCS, Cognizant, Wipro, Capgemini, Infosys, Amazon, Tech Mahindra.
- Highest Package: 18 LPA | Average Package: 5.2 LPA.
3. Hostel Accommodation & Student Life:
 - Dedicated on-campus and proximate hostels for male and female students.
- Hygienic mess catering vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals, gymnasium, and 24/7 security.
